what has he shipped on azure?.answer: He shipped a document-intelligence assistant for an enterprise consulting client on Azure, built with Azure OpenAI GPT-4o, Azure AI Search, LangGraph, FastAPI, React, and Cosmos DB Gremlin.

what broke in production and how did he.answer: The production issue was that a backend error was silently swallowed, causing the system to return a seemingly healthy but nearly empty directory listing instead of propagating the failure. He discovered it by tracing the code path and noticing that the behavior contradicted the documented invariant that backend errors must not be treated as partial success.

how does he decide when multi-agent is w.answer: He weighs the 70 % reduction in redundant LLM calls and state isolation against the added orchestration complexity.
